name: Motora Yuujirou
source:
A detective at the Shinjuku Police Station. Formerly a police officer, he is now in charge of investigating murders and violent crimes. Due to his aggressiveness in investigations and general poor conduct, the chief of the police department forces him to be an advisor to a new detective. Even though he was resistant at first, the two seem to make a suprisingly good team.

[From [url=https://tokyo-psychodemic.com/?lang=en]Official Website[/url]]
